title: A spectrum with an alternative explanation
promptMarkdown: Two otherwise comparable hypothetical octahedral d¹ complexes absorb at 640 nm and 480 nm. Assume each band is the single d-shell gap. Calculate molar splitting energies using h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J s, c=2.99792458×10⁸ m s⁻¹ and N_A=6.02214076×10²³ mol⁻¹. Which has larger splitting, by what ratio? A third d¹⁰ complex is strongly coloured. Explain why this does not refute its electron count, and propose a measurement or analysis to investigate the colour mechanism.
hintLadder: Convert nm to metres and distinguish one photon from one mole of photons.
Take the ratio before detailed arithmetic.
The absence of d–d transitions is not the absence of every possible transition.
